title: Air Quality (UCI) — Hourly pollutant concentrations, temperature and humidity from an Italian city, 2004–2005
summary: Hourly averaged readings from a gas multisensor device deployed at road level in an Italian city, March 2004 – February 2005 (9358 instances). Includes reference-analyzer ground-truth concentrations for CO (mg/m³), Non-Metanic HydroCarbons (µg/m³), Benzene (µg/m³), NOx (ppb) and NO2 (µg/m³) — with NO2 being directly relevant to the air-quality use case. Also provides temperature (°C), relative humidity (%) and absolute humidity, plus five sensor-channel responses (PT08.S1–S5). Missing values use the sentinel -200. The city is unspecified but described as Italian and highly polluted. The dataset matches the prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) exactly.

schema.notes: Missing values encoded as -200 (sentinel). The metadata schema declared 'has_missing_values: no' but the notes text and data sample confirm -200 is used extensively. NMHC(GT) has 90.2% missing (8443 of 9357 rows are -200). CO(GT), NOx(GT), NO2(GT) have ~16-17% missing. Sensor channels PT08.S1–S5 and T/RH/AH each have ~3.9% missing (366 rows).

documentation_excerpts: Abstract: 'Contains the responses of a gas multisensor device deployed on the field in an Italian city. Hourly responses averages are recorded along with gas concentrations references from a certified analyzer.'
Notes from UCI page: 'The dataset contains 9358 instances of hourly averaged responses … from March 2004 to February 2005 (one year) … at road level, within an Italian city.'
Notes: 'Missing values are tagged with -200 value.'
Notes: 'This dataset can be used exclusively for research purposes. Commercial purposes are fully excluded.'
Notes: 'Evidences of cross-sensitivities as well as both concept and sensor drifts are present … eventually affecting sensors concentration estimation capabilities.'
quality_notes: Missing-value encoding is -200; UCI metadata declares 'has_missing_values: no' but the notes and data prove otherwise. 9357 rows (entire file) sampled from 9358 declared instances — one row difference unexplained.
NMHC(GT) has 90.2% missing (-200), making it effectively unusable.
NO2(GT) — the primary pollutant needed — has ~17.5% missing (1642 of 9357 rows are -200).
Sensor-drift and cross-sensitivity issues are documented in the source paper (De Vito et al., 2008).
Licence ambiguity: CC BY 4.0 is declared via the licence field on the page, but the notes section restricts to research only (no commercial use).
The city name is not explicitly provided in the dataset metadata, only described as 'an Italian city'. This may not match Valdena specifically.
